messages.description:
These are the messages that will be spoken to the user as the tool is running.

For some tools, this is auto-filled based on special fields like `tool.destinations`. For others like the function tool, these can be custom configured.

headers.description: JSON schema for headers the model should populate when sending the SIP request.

body.description: Body to include in the SIP request. Either a literal string body, or a JSON schema describing a structured body that the model should populate.
